_comment: Nutrients tracked by Complex Nutrition. Each nutrient's unit is the one food profiles store it in (per 100 g) and the one it is shown in: kcal for calories, g for the macros and fiber, mg or mcg for vitamins and minerals (since v0.3.2), and %DV for the B vitamins, a mix of six. dailyTarget is in that unit. Daily values for micronutrients are the US FDA adult Daily Values (21 CFR 101.9), as listed by NIH ODS; macro targets are the game's own design targets. Tracking (v0.2) keeps a reserve per nutrient in % of its daily target. Since v0.2.2 calories are a reserve filled only by digestion, and fat, protein and carbohydrate are gut pools whose size (cap) comes from maxGrams in config/digestion.json; they do not drain or use the sitting limit. For the rest: cap is the most the body stores, startReserve what a new character starts with, drainPerDay what a day uses (calories follow the game's hunger rate instead), and sittingLimit the intake in one sitting above which the extra is absorbed at a falling rate. drainPerDay and sittingLimit default to 100 and 150. capPerTier (since v0.4.1, calories only) is how much bigger the store gets for each diet tier above the first (0 until v0.4.4). Since v0.4.0 the slow stores (vitamins A, D, E and K and the minerals) hold 20 days each, one for every 1% of their effect's bonus (config/effects.json).

nutrients.source: Design target: an active day (FDA reference is 2,000 kcal). Since v0.4.1 the reserve holds 4 active days (11,200 kcal); capPerTier will add 2 days for each diet tier above the first in v0.4.4, when cap drops to 2 days; until then it is 0, so the diet tier does not change the reserve

Design target: at least 0.8 g per kg of bodyweight for an 80 kg character, enough to keep existing muscle (FDA DV 50 g). The body uses up to 128 g a day (1.6 g per kg, enough to build muscle). Keep in step with the protein pool in digestion.json (diminishingAboveGrams 64, taperEndGrams 128)
Mean %DV of thiamin (1.2 mg), riboflavin (1.3 mg), niacin (16 mg), B6 (1.7 mg), folate (400 mcg DFE) and B12 (2.4 mcg), each capped at 300%
